name: Click Indicators
description: Shows where a macro's clicks are, in the level and on a rhythm lane, instead of playing them. Reads .gdr2, .gdr and .xd (xdBot) and .slc (Silicate).

enabled.name: Master enable
enabled.description: Turns the whole mod on or off. Applies immediately, no level reload.

cheat-indicator.name: Flag as a cheat
cheat-indicator.description: Reports to MegaHack, Eclipse and other cheat indicators while this mod is active. Needs the Cheat API mod installed.

timing-offset.name: Timing offset (ms)
timing-offset.description: Shifts every indicator. Negative makes them arrive earlier, positive later.

look-ahead.name: Look ahead (seconds)
look-ahead.description: How far into the future to show clicks in the level.

max-notes.name: Max indicators on screen
max-notes.description: Hard cap on how many upcoming presses draw at once, in the level and in the lane. Dense macros bury the screen without this.

p2-color.name: Player 2 colour
p2-color.description: Used for the second input stream in dual macros. Ignored on single macros.

line-width.name: Tap line thickness
line-width.description: In level units. One block is 30. Holds use their real length instead.

tap-ms.name: Tap threshold (ms)
tap-ms.description: A press shorter than this draws as a tap, longer as a hold. In milliseconds, so it works on 240 tps and 1200 tps macros alike.

edge-marker.name: Click marker on edge
edge-marker.description: Draws a solid line on the leading edge of every indicator, which is the frame you press on.

hold-tracks.name: Holds drain as you hold
hold-tracks.description: Once the press frame passes, the bar's leading edge follows you and the bar shrinks. What's left of it is how much hold is left.

press-badge.name: Badge on the press edge
press-badge.description: A small hollow square riding the press edge of every indicator, level with your player. Easier to track than a full height line.

player-square.name: Target square on player
player-square.description: A square at your hitbox centre, matching the badges on the indicators. A badge sitting centred inside it is perfect timing.

badge-size.name: Badge size
badge-size.description: Width of the square on the press edge, in screen units. It stays this size no matter how far the level zooms out.

player-line.name: Show line on player
player-line.description: Draws a line through your icon. An indicator touching it is the exact frame the macro clicks.

lane.name: Show rhythm lane
lane.description: A ladder at the edge of the screen. Upcoming presses are rungs that descend toward the hit bar, which flashes green on a hit and red on a miss.

lane-side.name: Lane side
lane-side.description: Which edge the rhythm lane sits on. Middle lays it flat across the top of the screen instead, with notes running in sideways to a receptor at one end. Upside down lane swaps which end that is.

mid-lane-hit.name: Middle lane hit position
mid-lane-hit.description: Where the hit line sits along the screen when the lane is set to Middle, as a fraction of screen width in from the near edge. Higher moves your aim point towards the centre. Notes use whatever space is left, so raising this shortens the run-in.

lane-window.name: Lane window (seconds)
lane-window.description: How much time the ladder covers from top to hit line. Lower means faster, more precise notes.

lane-scale.name: Ladder size
lane-scale.description: Overall size of the ladder. 1.0 matches the reference proportions.

lane-depth.name: Ladder perspective
lane-depth.description: How hard the ladder tapers toward the top. Higher is a steeper vanishing point. 1.15 matches the reference.

note-shape.name: Note shape
note-shape.description: Slab is the perspective ladder. Circle is a flat osu mania lane: dots for taps, grey capsules for holds, no perspective.

lane-flip.name: Upside down lane
lane-flip.description: Flips the rhythm lane: notes travel upward into receptors at the top instead of falling downward. Works for both note shapes.

p2-lane.name: Split lane for dual
p2-lane.description: Widens the rhythm lane into two columns, player 1 left and player 2 right. Off puts both in one column, told apart by colour.

accuracy.name: Score my clicks
accuracy.description: Rates every click you make against the macro and shows the verdict beside the lane.

perfect-ms.name: Perfect window (ms)
perfect-ms.description: Within this many milliseconds of the macro counts as perfect. In real time, so it means the same thing on a 60 tps macro and a 1200 tps one.

ok-ms.name: OK window (ms)
ok-ms.description: Outside perfect but inside this counts as OK, shading from yellow to orange. Beyond it is a miss.
